raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Pipeline-parallel EAGLE/MTP speculative decoding crashes on the first mixed batch when `SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC=1` and `--enable-mixed-chunk` are used together. The mixed batch carries `EagleDraftInput`, while the PP verify rebuild path expects `PPSpecRelayInput` and accesses its `rids` field.

Until the PP relay supports mixed batches, turn this unsupported combination into a startup-time configuration downgrade instead of a scheduler crash.

Fixes #42648.

## Modifications

- Disable mixed chunked prefill when aggregate PP speculative decoding is enabled (`pp_size > 1` with `SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC=1`).
- Emit a targeted warning when the downgrade is applied.
- Preserve mixed chunking for single-stage speculative decoding and PP speculative PD-prefill.
- Move the existing no-server PP-spec gate tests from the multi-GPU E2E file to the server-argument unit suite, and add regression coverage for the downgrade and both preserved configurations.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This changes startup argument resolution only; model forward code and model outputs are unchanged.

Focused tests:

- `TestPipelineParallelCompat` + `TestPPSpecGate`: 17/17 passed in the official SGLang container without GPU passthrough.
- Controlled resolution check: unpatched `main` keeps `enable_mixed_chunk=True`; this patch logs the warning and resolves it to `False` for aggregate PP spec.
- `pre-commit run --all-files`: passed.

The provided validation VM exposes one A100, so the original `pp_size=2` scheduler reproduction could not be run locally.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. The added check runs once during server argument resolution and does not affect the inference hot path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No documentation update is needed for this internal compatibility downgrade.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable; model outputs and the inference hot path are unchanged.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class TestPPSpecGate(CustomTestCase):
+    """Validate the experimental aggregate PP speculative decoding gate."""
+
+    def _server_args(self, **overrides):
+        from sglang.test.mock_model.utils import MOCK_MODEL_PATH
+
+        args = dict(
+            model_path=MOCK_MODEL_PATH,
+            pp_size=2,
+            disable_overlap_schedule=True,
+            speculative_algorithm="EAGLE",
+            speculative_draft_model_path=MOCK_MODEL_PATH,
+            speculative_num_steps=2,
+            speculative_eagle_topk=1,
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=3,
+        )
+        args.update(overrides)
+        server_args = ServerArgs(**args)
+        # check_server_args reads resolution-filled fields (served_model_name,
+        # chunked_prefill_size); the bare constructor leaves them None.
+        server_args.resolve_once()
+        return server_args
+
+    def test_gate_off_keeps_the_ban(self):
+        os.environ.pop("SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC", None)
+        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+            self._server_args().check_server_args()
+
+    def test_gate_on_rejects_unsupported_combinations(self):
+        os.environ["SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC"] = "1"
+        try:
+            self._server_args().check_server_args()
+            # DP attention partitions the batch per DP rank, so the stages
+            # would no longer rebuild the same verify tree.
+            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+                self._server_args(tp_size=2, attn_dp_size=2).check_server_args()
+            # Adaptive spec changes num_draft_tokens at runtime, which the
+            # relay slices results with.
+            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+                self._server_args(
+                    speculative_adaptive=True, speculative_num_steps=3
+                ).check_server_args()
+            # The relay carries an EAGLE-shaped tree; other algorithms would
+            # be mis-rebuilt on the non-last stages.
+            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+                self._server_args(
+                    speculative_algorithm="NGRAM", speculative_draft_model_path=None
+                ).check_server_args()
+            # PD prefill needs the RelayPayload draft fields the gated flow
+            # does not carry.
+            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
+                self._server_args(disaggregation_mode="prefill").check_server_args()
+        finally:
+            os.environ.pop("SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC", None)
+
+    def test_gate_on_disables_mixed_chunk(self):
+        os.environ["SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC"] = "1"
+        try:
+            with self.assertLogs(
+                "sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook", level="WARNING"
+            ) as logs:
+                server_args = self._server_args(enable_mixed_chunk=True)
+
+            self.assertFalse(resolution_result(server_args, "enable_mixed_chunk"))
+            self.assertIn(
+                "pipeline-parallel speculative decoding does not support it",
+                "\n".join(logs.output),
+            )
+            server_args.check_server_args()
+        finally:
+            os.environ.pop("SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC", None)
+
+    def test_single_stage_spec_keeps_mixed_chunk(self):
+        os.environ["SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC"] = "1"
+        try:
+            server_args = self._server_args(pp_size=1, enable_mixed_chunk=True)
+            self.assertTrue(resolution_result(server_args, "enable_mixed_chunk"))
+            server_args.check_server_args()
+        finally:
+            os.environ.pop("SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC", None)
+
+    def test_pd_prefill_keeps_mixed_chunk(self):
+        os.environ.pop("SGLANG_ENABLE_PP_SPEC", None)
+        server_args = self._server_args(
+            disaggregation_mode="prefill", enable_mixed_chunk=True
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(resolution_result(server_args, "enable_mixed_chunk"))
+        server_args.check_server_args()
+
